text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today! See you tomorrow, 
Trainer♪

After going out with Super Creek, I 
suddenly remembered that day—

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle 
Series are immensely important to an 
Umamusume, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"With such naive thinking, an Umamusume 
will never grow..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer cares about me. It's okay, there's 
nothing to worry about~.

"...I decided to study so that I could be 
of even a little help to Super Creek."

And the next day, and the day after 
that... As I continued studying training 
methods late into the night—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm just worried about Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've been studying late into the night 
for quite a while now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If this continues, you will ruin your 
health.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your hardworking nature is wonderful, 
but... pushing yourself recklessly is a 
big no-no.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We can just think through the training 
together and work hard on it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to push yourself so hard 
all on your own.
choice_data_list: It's for my own sake too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...If that is the case, please, at least 
rest for today.

Super Creek looks like she's about to 
cry... I really shouldn't make her worry 
so much.
The moment I stood up to head home—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

...Everything before my eyes went pitch 
black.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah... Did you notice?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, she collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I believe it's likely due to lack of 
sleep... In any case, you're pushing 
yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Am I... making you feel uneasy?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Pushing yourself to study until you 
collapse...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If being my Trainer is cornering you like 
this, then..."
choice_data_list: I'm anxious because I'm not good enough.

I'm anxious because I'm just not good 
enough, you know.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If being my Trainer is cornering you like 
this, then..."
choice_data_list: I'm anxious because I'm not good enough.

I'm anxious because I'm just not good 
enough, you know.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm glad. Hearing you put it so 
clearly puts my mind at ease."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: To me, you're my one and only Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The more you push yourself too hard, 
Trainer, the more worried I become.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So please, put my mind more at ease.
choice_data_list: I'll be careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. In that case, I'll sing a lullaby 
for them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Be a good child and go night-night now♪

With gentle pats on my blanket and Super 
Creek's lullaby, I was lulled peacefully 
to sleep...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're already doing more than 
enough for me as it is.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone says, it doesn't 
matter. Let's just take things at our own 
pace, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, if it makes you anxious, 
Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll pamper you so much that all those 
worries will just blow away!
choice_data_list:
Even as it is, that's already more than 
enough—!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, I'm sure it's not enough.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, maybe I should start by sleeping 
beside you? I'm gonna pamper you ever so 
much~♪

I declined the offer to sleep together and 
promised not to push myself too hard in 
the future...
